title: Xanadu and ASML Team Up on Lithography to Smooth the "Light Paths" in Photonic Quantum Chips
excerpt: On September 9, 2026, Xanadu and ASML announced a collaboration to develop lithography processes for photonic quantum chips. A beginner-friendly look at how tiny roughness in light paths relates to loss, the technical background, what has not been disclosed, and what to check next.
